# 12-Week Strength Programme
### Client Profile & Programming Logic

---

## Foundational Notes Before the Plan

**Client:** 34F, intermediate lifter, Stage III endometriosis
**Programme start:** 2026-06-01 | **Programme end:** 2026-08-23

**Cycle mapping across 12 weeks**

Using last period 2026-05-04, 27-day cycle, 4 flow days:

| Cycle | Menstruation (Flow Days) | Estimated Ovulation | Luteal Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cycle 2 | **May 31 – Jun 3** (bleeds into Week 1) | ~Jun 13–14 | Jun 14 – May 30 |
| Cycle 3 | **Jun 27 – Jun 30** | ~Jul 10–11 | Jul 11 – Jul 26 |
| Cycle 4 | **Jul 24 – Jul 27** | ~Aug 6–7 | Aug 7 – Aug 23 |

> **Note on Cycle 3 ovulation:** Estimated ovulation falls ~Jul 10–11, which coincides with the first acyclic flare window (Jul 10–13, post-laparoscopy follow-up). This is a double-restriction overlap and is treated with maximum caution — that entire window is active recovery only.

**Restriction days across the programme (no HIIT, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping):**

| Window | Reason | Dates |
|---|---|---|
| Flow Window 1 | Menstruation (bleeds from prior cycle) | Jun 1–3 |
| Flow Window 2 | Menstruation | Jun 27–30 |
| Flare Window 1 | Post-laparoscopy follow-up + ovulation overlap | Jul 10–13 |
| Flow Window 3 | Menstruation | Jul 24–27 |
| Flare Window 2 | Stress-correlated flare | Aug 4–7 |
| Flow Window 4 | Menstruation | Aug 20–23 |

**On all restriction days, apply the following substitutions universally:**
- Replace barbell back squat → goblet squat or leg press (light-moderate, no breath-hold)
- Replace conventional/Romanian deadlift → single-leg RDL with dumbbell or cable pull-through
- Replace barbell overhead press → seated dumbbell press or cable lateral raises
- No box jumps, no plyometrics, no sprint intervals
- Core work: replace heavy loaded carries and bracing-intensive movements → dead bugs, supported bird-dogs, pelvic tilts
- RPE ceiling of 6/10 on restriction days; prioritise movement quality and parasympathetic recovery

---

## Programme Architecture

The 12 weeks are divided into three 4-week phases, each with a distinct training stimulus. Intensity and volume are deliberately modulated around restriction windows so that the heaviest loading always falls in the follicular and mid-luteal sweet spots, where research on cycle-synced training suggests neuromuscular output and recovery capacity are highest.

**Phase 1 — Weeks 1–4: Foundation & Movement Quality (Jun 1–28)**
Establish baseline strength, refine technique, build connective tissue tolerance. Moderate volume, moderate intensity (RPE 6–7.5). Three full-body sessions per week.

**Phase 2 — Weeks 5–8: Hypertrophy & Strength Bridge (Jun 29–Jul 26)**
Increase volume and introduce upper/lower split. Intensity climbs to RPE 7–8.5. Flare Window 1 (Jul 10–13) sits inside Week 7 and is programmed as a full deload/active recovery week.

**Phase 3 — Weeks 9–12: Strength Peaking & Performance (Jul 27–Aug 23)**
Lower volume, higher intensity (RPE 8–9). Flare Window 2 (Aug 4–7) falls in Week 10 and is managed as a mid-week deload insert. Flow Window 4 (Aug 20–23) closes the programme with a planned taper.

**Session structure throughout:** Warm-up (8–10 min) → Main work → Accessory work → Cool-down/mobility (5–8 min). Warm-up always includes 5 minutes of low-intensity cardio (bike or row, not running on restriction days), hip 90/90 mobility, glute activation, and scapular prep.

---

---

# PHASE 1 — Foundation & Movement Quality
## Weeks 1–4 | June 1–28

**Phase goals:** Establish a reliable 3-day training rhythm; build posterior chain and hip stability; identify working weights for all primary lifts; introduce progressive overload at a conservative rate (add 2.5–5 kg to lower body lifts and 1.25–2.5 kg to upper body lifts when all prescribed reps are completed with RPE ≤ 7.5).

**Session split:** Full Body A / Full Body B / Full Body C, trained Monday/Wednesday/Friday or equivalent non-consecutive days.

---

### Week 1 | June 1–7
**Restriction days: Jun 1–3 (flow days — apply all substitutions)**

This week opens mid-flow, so Monday and Wednesday fall under restriction protocol. Friday (Jun 6) is unrestricted and serves as the first full-effort session of the programme. Use the early sessions to establish movement patterns at low intensity rather than viewing them as lost training days — they are intentional on-ramps.

**Monday June 1 — Session A (Restriction Protocol)**
*RPE ceiling 6. No Valsalva, no jumping, no HIIT.*

Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, hip 90/90 (60 sec/side), clamshells 2×15, scapular wall slides 2×10.

- Goblet squat — 3×12 @ RPE 5, 2-second descent, pause 1 sec at bottom. Focus: vertical torso, knees tracking toes, exhale on ascent without aggressive breath-hold.
- Seated dumbbell press — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Focus: controlled eccentric, neutral wrist.
- Single-leg RDL (dumbbell, ipsilateral) — 3×10/side @ RPE 5. Focus: hip hinge, pelvis level, soft knee.
- Seated cable row — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Focus: retract scapulae before pulling, no lumbar extension.
- Dead bug — 3×8/side, slow and controlled. No breath-holding; exhale throughout the movement.
- Pelvic tilts supine — 2×15. Gentle lumbar mobility and parasympathetic activation.

Cool-down: 5 min supine hip flexor stretch, figure-four glute stretch, diaphragmatic breathing 2 min.

**Wednesday June 3 — Session B (Restriction Protocol)**
*RPE ceiling 6. Last flow day — same substitution rules apply.*

Warm-up: as Monday.

- Leg press (moderate load) — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Feet hip-width, full range without lumbar rounding.
- Dumbbell Romanian deadlift — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Both legs, light load, hinge emphasis.
- Incline dumbbell press — 3×12 @ RPE 5.
- Lat pulldown — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Full stretch at top, drive elbows to hips.
- Cable pull-through — 3×12 @ RPE 5. Hip hinge pattern, glute squeeze at lockout.
- Supported bird-dog — 3×8/side. Contralateral arm/leg, 3-sec hold, exhale throughout.

Cool-down: cat-cow 2×10, child's pose 60 sec, supine twist 45 sec/side.

**Friday June 6 — Session C (Unrestricted — First Full Session)**
*RPE ceiling 7.5. Establish working weights for all primary lifts.*

Warm-up: 5 min bike, hip 90/90, glute bridges 2×15, band pull-aparts 2×15, empty-bar squat 2×8.

- Barbell back squat — 4×6 @ RPE 7. Record weight. This is your baseline. Controlled descent (3 sec), brief pause, drive through heels. Valsalva permitted — teach proper intra-abdominal pressure technique.
- Barbell Romanian deadlift — 3×8 @ RPE 7. Hip hinge, bar stays close to shins, slight knee bend.
- Barbell overhead press — 3×8 @ RPE 7. Strict, no leg drive. Rib cage down, glutes engaged.
- Barbell bent-over row — 3×8 @ RPE 7. 45-degree torso, pull to lower sternum.
- Bulgarian split squat (bodyweight or light DBs) — 2×10/side. Introduce the pattern; load is secondary.
- Plank — 3×30 sec. Neutral spine, breathe normally, no aggressive Valsalva.

Cool-down: pigeon pose 90 sec/side, thoracic extension over foam roller 2 min, hamstring stretch 60 sec/side.

---

### Week 2 | June 8–14
**No restriction days this week. Full training across all three sessions.**
*Estimated follicular phase — neuromuscular output typically elevated. Good week to push technique and begin progressive loading.*

**Monday June 8 — Session A**
*RPE ceiling 7.5.*

Warm-up: 5 min bike, hip 90/90, clamshells 2×15, band pull-aparts 2×15, empty-bar warm-up sets.

- Barbell back squat — 4×6 @ RPE 7.5. Add 2.5–5 kg from Friday's baseline if RPE was ≤7.
- Barbell Romanian deadlift — 3×8 @ RPE 7.5.
- Barbell overhead press — 3×8 @ RPE 7.5.
- Seated cable row — 3×10 @ RPE 7.
- Bulgarian split squat — 3×8/side @ RPE 6.5. Add light dumbbells if bodyweight felt easy.
- Pallof press — 3×10/side. Anti-rotation core; exhale on press, no breath-hold.

Cool-down: hip flexor stretch, pigeon pose, thoracic mobility.

**Wednesday June 10 — Session B**
*RPE ceiling 7.5.*

Warm-up: as Monday.

- Conventional deadlift — 4×5 @ RPE 7.5. Establish deadlift baseline. Brace, hinge, drive floor away.
- Incline barbell press — 3×8 @ RPE 7.5.
- Lat pulldown — 3×10 @ RPE 7.
- Leg press — 3×10 @ RPE 7. Use as supplemental quad volume.
- Dumbbell lateral raise — 3×12 @ RPE 6.5.
- Cable pull-through — 3×12 @ RPE 6.5.
- Dead bug — 3×8/side.

Cool-down: as Monday.

**Friday June 12 — Session C**
*RPE ceiling 7.5. Near estimated ovulation — energy and strength typically peak.*

Warm-up: as Monday.

- Barbell back squat — 4×5 @ RPE 7.5. Slight load increase if Wednesday felt strong.
- Barbell bent-over row — 4×6 @ RPE 7.5.
- Dumbbell walking lunge — 3×10/side @ RPE 6.5. Introduce unilateral lower body volume.
- Dumbbell incline press — 3×10 @ RPE 7.
- Face pull — 3×15 @ RPE 6. Shoulder health accessory.
- Plank — 3×35 sec.

Cool-down: full lower body stretch sequence, 5 min.

---

### Week 3 | June 15–21
**No restriction days. Mid-luteal phase — maintain intensity, watch for any fatigue signals.**
*Progressive overload continues. Add load where RPE was ≤7.5 last week.*

**Monday June 15 — Session A**
*RPE ceiling 8.*

Warm-up: standard protocol.

- Barbell back squat — 4×5 @ RPE 8. Increase load 2.5–5 kg from Week 2 if earned.
- Barbell Romanian deadlift — 4×6 @ RPE 8.
- Barbell overhead press — 3×6 @ RPE 8.
- Seated cable row — 3×10 @ RPE 7.5.
- Bulgarian split squat — 3×8/side @ RPE 7. Increase dumbbell load.
- Pallof press — 3×12/side.

Cool-down: standard.

**Wednesday June 17 — Session B**
*RPE ceiling 8.*

Warm-up: standard.

- Conventional deadlift — 4×4 @ RPE 8. Load increase from Week 2.
- Incline barbell press — 3×6 @ RPE 8.
- Lat pulldown — 3×10 @ RPE 7.5.
- Leg press — 3×10 @ RPE 7.5.
- Dumbbell lateral raise — 3×12 @ RPE 7.
- Cable pull-through — 3×12 @ RPE 7.
- Dead bug — 3×10/side.

Cool-down: standard.

**Friday June 19 — Session C**
*RPE ceiling 8.*

Warm-up: standard.

- Barbell back squat — 4×4 @ RPE 8.
- Barbell bent-over row — 4×5 @ RPE 8.
- Dumbbell walking lunge — 3×10/side @ RPE 7.
- Dumbbell incline press — 3×8 @ RPE 7.5.
- Face pull — 3×15 @ RPE 6.5.
- Plank — 3×40 sec.

Cool-down: standard.

---

### Week 4 | June 22–28
**Restriction days: Jun 27–28 (flow days — Saturday and Sunday, outside training days if Mon/Wed/Fri schedule is followed). If client trains on Saturday, apply restriction protocol.**

*This is a planned deload week within Phase 1. Reduce load by 10–15%, maintain rep ranges. Allow the body to consolidate adaptations before Phase 2 ramps up. Late luteal phase often brings increased fatigue and mood sensitivity — a deload here is physiologically and psychologically well-timed.*

**Monday June 22 — Session A (Deload)**
*RPE ceiling 6.5. Reduce all loads by 10–15% from Week 3.*

Warm-up: standard, add extra hip mobility work.

- Barbell back squat — 3×6 @ RPE 6.5.
- Barbell Romanian deadlift — 3×8 @ RPE 6.5.
- Barbell overhead press — 3×8 @ RPE 6.5.
- Seated cable row — 3×12 @ RPE 6.
- Bulgarian split squat — 2×8/side @ RPE 6.
- Dead bug — 3×8/side.

Cool-down: extended, 10 min. Include diaphragmatic breathing and progressive muscle relaxation.

**Wednesday June 24 — Session B (Deload)**
*RPE ceiling 6.5.*

Warm-up: standard.

- Conventional deadlift — 3×5 @ RPE 6.5.
- Incline barbell press — 3×8 @ RPE 6.5.
- Lat pulldown — 3×12 @ RPE 6.

# PHASE 2 — Hypertrophy & Strength Bridge
## Weeks 5–8 | June 29–July 26

**Phase goals:** Increase total training volume through an upper/lower split (4 sessions per week where restriction days allow); drive hypertrophy in the 8–12 rep range while introducing heavier strength work in the 4–6 rep range; build work capacity ahead of the peaking phase.

**Session split:** Lower A / Upper A / Lower B / Upper B — Monday/Tuesday/Thursday/Friday. This split allows Wednesday as a natural rest day and keeps heavy lower body sessions away from consecutive days.

**Progressive overload target:** 2.5–5 kg lower body, 1.25–2.5 kg upper body per week when all reps completed at RPE ≤8.
